# Pinned GLSL extended instructions

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers/tree/86f980c731e62ae4eaf383d320449d71687936bf

The unmodified `GLSL.std.450.h` supplies instruction numbers.
`tools/generate_glsl_std450.py` authenticates it and generates Zig names.
The retained upstream license applies. No runtime dependency on system headers.
